name: Hartley Roofing

goal.headline: More roofing jobs from people who find you online.
goal.lead: Your work is good. Your website should win you the next job.

noticed.text: You took on two new roofers in September.
Your reviews praise the work, and two say your website was hard to use.
Your website has no quote form and one page for every service.

noticed_summary: You are growing, and your website is behind your work.

look_at_first.title: A quote form on every page
look_at_first.text: People can ask for a price in a minute, from their phone.

look_at_first.title: A page for each kind of job
look_at_first.text: Flat roofs, repairs and new roofs each get found on their own.

look_at_first.title: Your reviews up front
look_at_first.text: The praise you already earn helps you win the next job.

example.heading: One page, before and after.
example.lead: Here is your repairs page, as it is and as it could be.

before.title: Today
before.text: One long page lists every service. There is a phone number, and no way to ask for a quote.

after.title: With us
after.text: A repairs page with photos of your work, three reviews and a quote form that texts you.
